Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass covering branded Resend emails and email_status field — POST /api/quotes background sends 'Request email sent' within ~5s (polled up to 12s, observed set reliably); staff confirm via POST /api/admin/quotes/{id} with final_price_usd sets email_status='Confirmation email sent' synchronously; Unavailable does not overwrite to any Confirmation value; Confirmed without final price -> HTTP 400; regression 401 (no token) and 403 (member hitting /admin/*) both hold. critical_code_review_comments: server.py _send_request_received: background task; if the quote doc is deleted before the task runs (unlikely race), a NoneType access on doc would raise — not blocking, but defensive None check is cheap.

server.py admin_update_quote awaits emailer.send_email synchronously for Confirmed — acceptable latency (~1s observed) but blocks the request; consider BackgroundTasks for symmetry if Resend latency grows.

emailer.py _assert_safe_email runs on every send; good G2/G3 guardrails. EMAIL_REPLY_TO is read from env — current value joshua@flysidra.com is forwarded as contact_email, so member Reply reaches the team.
team/[id].tsx correctly surfaces data.email_status in both the Cell and the saved banner with a clean fallback ('—') when null — matches review request wording.
